sections.bio:
I once audited a Shopify store doing $80k/month.

Great products. Strong brand. Loyal customers.

But 94% of their revenue came from paid ads.
- Turn off the ads? Revenue dies overnight.

I fixed that. Organic now drives 40% of their revenue. 

No ad spend. Just search.
That's what I do.

------
Hi, I'm Haseeb.

I help Shopify brands rank #1 on Google and AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) - and turn that traffic into actual revenue.

Rankings without conversions are vanity. I build systems that get you found *and* get you paid.

What I Do Differently

Most SEO freelancers run automated audits and send exported reports.
I don't.

I build custom strategies based on:

→ Deep technical audits
→ Competitor gap analysis
→ Search intent mapping
→ Conversion-focused content strategy
→ Authority link building
→ AI Search Optimization (GEO / AEO / LLM SEO)

As search evolves with AI platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google SGE, I make sure your brand is visible not just on Google, but across next-generation search engines.

Core Expertise

✔ Technical SEO & Site Architecture

3 years ago, this started after Zuhr prayer in a masjid ❤️

We were in our 4th semester.

I still remember sitting with Muhammad Saad Ahmed Siddiqui after namaz when he asked me:

“LinkedIn bani hui hai?”

I said:

“Han bani hui hai, lekin optimize nahi ki.”

That day, Muhammad Saad optimized my LinkedIn profile for the first time.

At that time, we were just students trying to figure things out.

No big network.
No strong personal brand.
No clear career direction.

Just two friends trying to start somewhere.

He was also the person I gave my first internship interview with & Alhamdulillah, we both got selected for internships at a UK-based Shopify agency.

That was the beginning of our careers.

Fast forward 3 years…

Saad is now at 9,600+ followers.
I’m at 9,400+ followers.

Alhamdulillah.

From sitting in the masjid after Zuhr discussing LinkedIn…

To now competing with each other on who reaches 10,000 followers first.

Along the way, we both started building our personal brands in our own niches

learning from those who OWN personal branding

Jasmin Alić , Sana Arif 🇵🇰 , Maheen Zafar , Aisha Riaz, Queen of LinkedIn: Lara Acosta , and many others who showed us what consistency really looks like.

and It's not about followers.
 - It’s about consistency.
 - It’s about starting early.
 - It’s about having the right people around you.

Sometimes, one small conversation can change your whole direction.

Now the challenge is simple:

Road to 10K.

Let’s see who reaches there first. 👀

Grateful for the journey, the friendship, and everything Allah has blessed us with.

Who do you think will hit 10K first?

Claude + Automation = unfair advantage.

While most people are asking AI questions...

Others are building systems that work while they sleep.

One workflow.

One setup.

5,000+ emails/day.

The gap between average and top performers isn't effort anymore.

It's leverage.

AI isn't replacing operators.

It's amplifying them.

Comment "Leads" and I will send you immediately.

Moment you realize the creators you learn from are now accepting your connection requests 👇

A few months ago, I was studying content from top voices in AI, SEO, and GEO.

Taking notes.

Saving posts.

Trying to understand how they think.

Today, one of Europe's top AI voices, (My Mentor) Anna York (125K+ followers), accepted my connection request ❤️

And it reminded me of something:

LinkedIn rewards consistency more than talent.

Most people focus on going viral.

How to get noticed by creators in your industry 👇

My workflow:

1. Learn publicly
2. Engage intentionally
3. Build authority
4. Connect strategically
5. Stay visible

You don't need millions of followers.

You need to be visible to the right people.

The opportunities usually start with a simple connection request.

Who's a creator you'd love to connect with next? - Mine Connor Gillivan

What if your eCommerce brand is already showing up in AI search, but you DON'T know it?

Generative AI in Google Search isn't a future thing anymore.

We checked Cardology's GSC last month:
28.9K impressions from AI features in 28 days.
↳ Sharp spike at the end.
↳ Not declining. Growing.

Here's what changed:
Ranking on Google isn't enough anymore.

AI search rewards:
  1. Topical authority (own your corner)
  2. Content clarity (explain, don't assume)
  3. Entity relevance (who are you talking to?)
  4. Product page structure (make it skimmable)
  5. Collection depth (show the full picture)
  6. Schema markup (speak Google's language)
  7. Buying guidance (help them decide)

Traditional SEO: "Rank here."
AI SEO: "Be selected, summarized, trusted."

If your content helps shoppers decide, AI features surface you.
If it doesn't, you disappear in the summary.

Are you tracking AI impressions yet?

Comment 'AI' and I'll send you the GSC metrics that matter.
